scoring_justification: The scored target is the relative ordering of G/B ratios; recomputing from raw DFT calculations would require re-running a full DFT elasticity workflow which is impractically expensive in the checker sandbox. T3 structural (inequality checks) is appropriate.

outputs.description: Computed elastic constants and polycrystalline moduli for ZrN, TiN, AlN, Zr0.50Ti0.50N, Zr0.50Al0.50N. Used to verify ductility trends via structural inequalities on G_over_B.

output_contract.notes: The checker verifies the following inequalities: G_over_B(Zr0.50Ti0.50N) < G_over_B(ZrN) and < G_over_B(TiN); G_over_B(Zr0.50Al0.50N) < G_over_B(ZrN) and < G_over_B(AlN). No tolerance on absolute values; only the relative ordering is required.

steps.description: Check G/B ductility ordering: ternary G/B must be less than parent binaries G/B.
